scenarios.title: Join the GSV ticket board
scenarios.body: Open tickets are the board for people who want to join. Claim via Galaxy or MCP gsv_tickets_claim.

scenarios.title: Drain next PH-S* band
scenarios.body: абракадабра / abrakadabra: products scan → S0 disk → warnings-first → one commit + push.

scenarios.title: Squad development ticket
scenarios.body: Assign to a random online MCP (squad). Solo mode uses the single MCP instead.

scenarios.title: Solo bot: Telegram ticket
scenarios.body: Ingest a Godfather /ticket message as a board row. The one online MCP claims it (tickets.mode=solo).

scenarios.title: PoolAI cargo test-ci
scenarios.body: Registered product poolai: run cargo test-ci with CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/s/rust/poolAI/target.

scenarios.title: Light Rust MDS app
scenarios.body: Solo bot walks this band: scaffold gsv-mds, memory probe, disk probe, speed probe, JSON wire + tests, Telegram sync on claim/done.

tickets.title: MDS: scaffold bin
tickets.body: Add boxes/mds.rs and src/bin/gsv_mds.rs. cargo run --bin gsv-mds.

tickets.title: MDS: memory probe
tickets.body: 1 MiB alloc sample plus OS phys (GlobalMemoryStatusEx on Windows).

tickets.title: MDS: JSON wire + tests
tickets.body: GET /api/mds, MCP gsv_mds, gsv_mds_contracts, cargo test.

tickets.title: MDS: solo walk Telegram sync
tickets.body: Claim/done each row; enqueue kind:sync envelopes. POST /api/tickets/walk.
